description: Implementation of the ModifyFeaturePropertyLiveCommand interface; provides methods to create instances, access properties, and modify command headers within the 'live' command context for feature property modifications.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturePropertyLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the ModifyFeaturePropertyLiveCommand interface, encapsulating modifications to feature properties in a live command context.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of ModifyFeaturePropertyLiveCommandImpl from a Command object, casting it to ModifyFeatureProperty.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the feature ID associated with the command.

methods.name: getPropertyPointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer to the property being modified.

methods.name: getPropertyValue
methods.description: Returns the new value for the property.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new command instance with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether the command changes authorization (returns false).

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Provides a builder for crafting responses to this command.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
